name: Gunplay
author: DeonUrist
summary: Real bullets, tracers, falloff, headshots and vehicle damage. Hold Reload to unload; preserve ammo overflow and per-gun magazines. Armor overflow returns plates. Replaces Apocaunloader.
deprecatedReason: Gunplay is included in Wild Wasteland 1.0. Install Wild Wasteland and disable this standalone plugin to avoid duplicate features. Keep existing configuration and data files for migration.
